an4.113:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave bhadro assājānīyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco bhadro assājānīyo patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati:
an4.113:1.4: “kiṃ nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kimassāhaṃ patikaromī”ti.
an4.113:1.5: eva rūpopi bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājānīyo hoti.
an4.113:1.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo bhadro assājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājānīyo naheva kho patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, api ca kho lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati :
an4.113:2.2: “kiṃnu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kimassāhaṃ patikaromī”ti.
an4.113:2.3: evarūpopi bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājānīyo hoti.
an4.113:2.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo bhadro assājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājānīyo naheva kho patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, napi lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati. api ca kho cammavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati:
an4.113:3.2: “kiṃnu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kimassāhaṃ patikaromī”ti.
an4.113:3.3: evarūpopi bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājānīyo hoti.
an4.113:3.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo bhadro assājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājānīyo naheva kho patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, napi lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, napi cammavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati. api ca kho aṭṭhivedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati:
an4.113:4.2: “kiṃnu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kimassāhaṃ patikaromī”ti.
an4.113:4.3: evarūpopi bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājānīyo hoti.
an4.113:4.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho bhadro assājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:4.5: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro bhadrā assājānīyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:5.1: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārome bhadrā purisājānīyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:5.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco bhadro purisājānīyo suṇāti
an4.113:5.4: amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthi vā puriso vā dukkhito vā kālakato vāti.
an4.113:5.7: pahitatto kāyena ceva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti, paññāya ca ativijjha passati.
an4.113:5.8: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave bhadro assājānīyo patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati,
an4.113:5.9: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ bhadraṃ purisājānīyaṃ vadāmi.
an4.113:5.10: evarūpopi bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro purisājānīyo hoti.
an4.113:5.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo bhadro purisājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro purisājānīyo naheva kho suṇāti
